restaurants.name: Strawberries
restaurants.description: Buy the 'sweet charlie' variety of strawberries from the main Mahabaleshwar Market. Alternatively, you can also venture out into interior parts to handpick your berries from the strawberry farms.

attractions.name: Apsara Vihar
attractions.description: Easily accessible from Jai Stambh, this 'fairy pool' is an ideal picnic spot for families with small children, since the pool is shallow, deepening only towards the base of the fall.

attractions.name: Bison Lodge
attractions.description: Constructed in 1862, the Bison Lodge is the oldest house in Pachmarhi. It now houses a beautiful museum depicting the rich flora and fauna of Pachmarhi.

attractions.name: Catholic Church
attractions.description: Built in 1892 by the British, the Catholic Church is a blend of the French and Irish architecture. Its Belgium stained-glass windows add rare attraction and beauty to the building. The church has a cemetery attached to it and graves date from 1859, World War I & II.

attractions.name: The Cave Shelters
attractions.description: Some of the best cave shelters and groups of shelters around Pachmarhi are: Dhuandhar, approached from the footpath to Apsara Vihar, the paintings mostly in white include a group of archers with the typical Gond bun and hooped earrings. Bharat Neer (Dorothy Deep), has well executed animal paintings and when excavated in the 1930s yielded many pottery shards and microliths. Asthachal (Monte Rosa), there are four shelters with paintings, comparatively early linear drawings. Along the northern side of Jambu Dwip valley are some six shelters with many paintings of animals and human figures, including a detailed battle scene.

attractions.name: Chauragarh
attractions.description: 4 km from Mahadeo, it is one of Satpura's prominent land marks, the summit crowned with emblems of Mahadeo worship.

attractions.name: Chhota Mahadeo
attractions.description: Revered as a sacred spot, this is a narrow point in the valley with rocks overhanging a stream and a spring from where water cascades down.

attractions.name: Christ Church
attractions.description: Built in 1875 by the British, this Church's architecture is fascinating; its 'sanctum-sanctorum' has a hemispherical dome on top with its ribs ending with faces of angels. The stained glass panes adorning the walls and rear of the altar were imported from Europe. They present a gorgeous view as the sun rays pass through them. The nave of the church does not contain even a single pillar for support. The baptismal font is a rare brass piece and the bell is as old as the church and its chimes can be heard from a long distance.

attractions.name: Dhoopgarh
attractions.description: The highest point in the Satpura range, with a magnificent view of the surrounding ranges. A very popular spot for viewing sunsets.

attractions.name: Handi Khoh
attractions.description: Pachmarhi's most impressive ravine has a 300 feet high precipice and dramatically steep sides.

attractions.name: Harper's Cave
attractions.description: So named because of one of its paintings - a man seated and playing a harp is close to the Jata Shankar Shrine. The Chieftain's Cave derives its name from a battle scene showing two chieftains on horses. A terrace that runs the length of the South, South East and East faces of Kites Crag has some fine cave paintings, the majority of which are in white or outlined in red.

attractions.name: Irene Pool
attractions.description: This pool was discovered by Irene Bose, wife of Justice Vivian Bose, and named after her. The route upstream leads to a cave, through which the stream goes underground and then over a khud in a series of falls.

attractions.name: Jalawataran
attractions.description: The descent is steep and the trek strenuous for almost all of the 4 km to the base of the fall's first cascade.

attractions.name: Jamuna Prapat
attractions.description: A spectacular fall in the stream which provides drinking water to Pachmarhi. The bathing pools above the fall are very popular.

attractions.name: Jata Shankar
attractions.description: A sacred cave under a mass of loose boulders in which the Jambu Dwip stream has its source. A rocky formation of this place resembles the matted locks of Lord Shiva, hence the name.

attractions.name: Mahadeo
attractions.description: Regarded as holy for countless of generations, Mahadeo hill has a shrine with an idol of Lord Shiva and an impressive Shivlinga. On the East side of the hill is an excellent cave shelter with beautiful cave paintings.

attractions.name: Pandav Caves
attractions.description: Five ancient dwellings excavated in the sandstone rock in a low hill. Pachmarhi derives its name from these caves which, as the legend goes, once provided sanctuary to the five Pandav brothers. These caves are now protected monuments.

attractions.name: Priyadarshini
attractions.description: This vantage viewing point marks the place from where Pachmarhi was discovered by Captain Forsyth in 1857. The British developed Pachmarhi as a resort and their influence is embodied in its churches and colonial architecture.

attractions.name: Rajat Prapat
attractions.description: Those seeking adventure will find it in this ten-minute walk over rocks and boulders from Apsara Vihar to the top of Rajat Prapat, the 'big fall'.

attractions.name: Reechhgarh
attractions.description: A wonderful natural amphitheater in the rock, approached through a cave-like entrance on the South-side.

attractions.name: Sangam
attractions.description: This is the lowest of the picnic spots on the Denwa and offers fairly good bathing pools both below and above the meeting of the waters.

attractions.name: Satpura National Park
attractions.description: Set up in 1981, Satpura National Park is 524 sq km in area. It spreads through dense forest of evergreen sal, teak and bamboo. The high peaks of Dhoopgarh and Mahadeo, Bori's legendary teak and bamboo forests, Pachmarhi's fascinating natural beauty of deep valleys, high mountains, rivulets, waterfalls and Tawa's vast reservoir combine to give this park unique beauty and a breathtaking variety of attractions. The park is home to the bison, tiger, Leopard, bear, four-horned deer, blue-bull and a rich variety of birds.

attractions.name: Sunder Kund
attractions.description: Crossing the stream below Duchess Fall and following a footpath about 2.5 km in a south- west direction, brings one to a huge rocky pool that is excellent for a refreshing swim.

attractions.name: Tridhara
attractions.description: A popular picnic spot where two streams meet in a junction.

attractions.name: Vanshree Vihar
attractions.description: A beautiful spot on the Denwa stream, cool and shady among trees, ferns and semi-tropical vegetation.

attractions.name: Living Root Bridges
attractions.description: The Living Root Bridges created by people of Khasi tribe is one of the most amazing examples of bio engineering. Created over years by carefully guiding the roots of Ficus benghalensis these bridges can last up to 500 years. The most famous Living Root Bridges are in the village of Nongriat and Mawlynnong.

attractions.name: Mawsmai Cave
attractions.description: An exciting and beautiful for adventure seekers. Most tourists explores the caves bare foot as the floor is damp. Some passageways are narrow and steep so a minimum level of fitness is required to view the cave in its entirety.

restaurants.name: Avron Restaurant
restaurants.description: Good vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. Diverse range of India, Chinese and international.

attractions.name: Cenotaphs
attractions.description: There are 14 Chhatris or Memorials to the rulers of Orchha, grouped along the Kanchan Ghat of the river Betwa on the south end of town. You can climb up to the roof for views of the river (keeper wants ₹100 tip for unlocking the stairs).

attractions.name: Chaturbhuj Temple
attractions.description: Built upon a massive stone platform and reached by a steep flight of steps, the temple was specially constructed to enshrine the image of Rama that remained in the Ram Raja Temple. Lotus emblems and other symbols of religious significance provide the delicate exterior ornamentation. Within, the sanctum is chastely plain with high, vaulted walls emphasizing its deep sanctity. Find the hidden stairs to the roof for a view of the entire area.

attractions.name: Fort Complex
attractions.description: The fort complex is a great place to visit; hit this first to obtain an all-day ticket good for all the sights in Orchha. Divided into 3 parts, it consists of:

attractions.name: Lakshmi-Narayan Temple
attractions.description: The style is an interesting synthesis of fort and temple moulds. The interiors contain the most exquisite of Orchha's wall paintings. Covering the walls and ceiling of three halls, these murals are vibrant compositions and cover a variety of spiritual and secular subjects. They are in excellent state of preservation, with the colours retaining their vivid quality.

attractions.name: Phool Bagh
attractions.description: Laid out as a formal garden, this complex testifies to the refined aesthetic qualities of the Bundelas. A central row of fountains culminates in an eight pillared palace-pavilion. A subterranean structure below was the cool summer retreat of the Orchha kings. An ingenious system of water ventilation connects the underground palace with Chandan Katora, a bowl-like structure from whose fountains droplets of water filtered through to the roof, simulating rainfall.

attractions.name: Ram Raja Mandir
attractions.description: This is the centre around which the life of Orchha revolves. The presiding Deity here is Lord Ram. The idols were meant to be installed in the magnificent Chaturbhuj temple, but when the idols, once kept on the ground (where they are today), refused to move. So a makeshift temple was built around it and is known as Ram Raja temple. It has an excellent courtyard, tiled with marble and the temple in pink and yellow colors, gives a bright look. No photography.

attractions.name: Sunder Mahal
attractions.description: This small palace, almost in ruins today is still a place of pilgrimage for Muslims. Dhurjban, son of Jhujhar, embraced Islam when he wed a Muslim girl at Delhi. He spent the latter part of his life in prayer and meditation and came to be revered as a saint.

attractions.name: Orchha Wildlife Sanctuary
attractions.description: This forest area includes most of the river island and is great for a hike. You can go by foot or enter with a vehicle. There is a 6-km hike there to the northern tip of the island and back. Right after the entrance go straight for 2 km and then follow the signs (then also in English). There is a nice river viewing point and a watchtower with a spectacular view on Orchha. Not many people go there. You can see monkeys, cows, wild boars (from afar), and chakals/foxes. Very relaxing.

restaurants.name: Indiana Restaurant
restaurants.description: Good reviews on Google are deserved, good food and friendly staff. Usually, only the upper terrace seems to be open for business.

restaurants.name: Grace of India
restaurants.description: Good food, family run restaurant. The son is chatty and has some good tips around the town. Try the fathers signature potato dish. Very good chai in a big mug. You can sit on the second floor with a nice view, but there is only one table there.

restaurants.name: Khajuraho Foo P
restaurants.description: Good, cheap food prepared by an adorable Indian woman named Puja and served by her friendly, talkative husband, Nayek. They also offer cooking classes: you choose what you want to learn from the menu, they take you to the kitchen and show you how to prepare it, and then you get to eat the final product. Even better, you pay what you think the cooking lesson was worth (plus the cost of the meal).
restaurants.address: Main Road, near Blue Sky Restaurant

restaurants.name: Krishna Palace View Roof Top Restaurant
restaurants.description: Restaurant with a beautiful view of the palace. You can enjoy tasty Indian, Chinese and Continental food. The dishes are prepared with fresh market produce. The menu offers many choices at attractive prices. But this place is primarily a meeting place and you will be warmly welcomed by Ravi.
restaurants.address: between hotel Ganpati and Fort view guesthouse

attractions.name: Virupaksha Temple
attractions.description: #5. Contrary to most other temples, this one is still a sacred place, so you will have to deposit your shoes in the shoe area left of the big entrance gate (putting them in your bag is not accepted if noticed).

attractions.name: Matanga Hill
attractions.description: #7. From where you can see the most beautiful sunsets.

attractions.name: Achyutaraya temple
attractions.description: #8. Built in 1534, it was the last temple executed in the city, before the fall of the fall of Vijayanagara Empire at the Battle of Talikota in the early 1565.

attractions.name: Vithala Temple
attractions.description: #23. Dedicated to Vithoba, an avatar (incarnation) of the gods Vishnu and Krishna. The famous Stone Chariot is here as well as the Musical Pillars.

attractions.name: Badavilinga Temple
attractions.description: #30. The largest monolithic linga (Shiva shrine) in Hampi.

attractions.name: Zanana Enclosure
attractions.description: #46. Also houses the Lotus Mahal and the Elephant Stables.

attractions.name: Elephant Stables
attractions.description: #55. Part of the Zanana Enclosures

attractions.name: Royal Enclosures
attractions.description: #61. Also referred to as the Royal Palace, in this area you'll find the Mahanavmi Dibba, Pushkarani step well and the Queen's bath.

attractions.name: Sanapur Lake
attractions.description: Exploring the hidden gems in the Gangavathi taluk, Sanapur Lake is a reservoir fed by Tungabhadra Dam canal. The unique thing about this place is experiencing the boat ride in a huge round, wooden bowl called Coracle. The Coracle gives a little adventurous feel. For a short ride it's usually ₹150 and for a long ride, it's ₹200 per person.

attractions.name: Golden Boulders Climbing & Adventure Shop
attractions.description: Main meeting point for climbers and boulderers. You can rent and buy equipment, meet fellow climbers over a cup of coffee, or book a climbing activity with Jerry, the owner (₹1000, usually in the morning). As he is also developing new sectors and opening lines on an almost daily basis (also, he is bolting routes from time to time), it's a good idea to start your bouldering trip with one of his activities to get to know the area and the rock.

restaurants.name: All Tribes Coffee Shop
restaurants.description: Great, cheap and open hangout place for travellers and backpackers. Get to know local people. The coffee shop serves coffee and Indian chai, cookies and other sweets. There is a fair trade shop and vegan friendly. During the day are many activities, like meditation, video screenings and camp fires. Family friendly.

restaurants.name: Chillout Restaurant
restaurants.description: Excellent food and very friendly staff. Try their divine Nargis Kofta. They also make decent pizza.

restaurants.name: Durga Roof Top
restaurants.description: Very good and authentic north Indian food and their Hello to the queen dessert is simply amazing.

restaurants.name: Mayura Bhuvaneshwari
restaurants.description: Hotel Mayura Bhuvaneshwari serves delicious buffet lunch for vegetarians. Approximately ₹100. If you plan your day such that you reach kamalapura around mid-day, this can be a great place for lunch. Unlimited food is served in very clean and serene surroundings. Even though it's a very popular and a very clean hotel, make sure you use packaged drinking water.

restaurants.name: Tom & Jerry
restaurants.description: Located on the east-side of the bazar-area near the boulders. Small but very comfortable rooftop-restaurant that serves delicious home-cooked food in a very friendly atmosphere.

attractions.name: Sanchi Stupas
attractions.description: The events of Buddha's life are carved in stone on the four gates at east, west, north and south sides of the Stupa. The site is very well maintained by the Archaelogical Survey of India. The Stupa and surrounding monuments have been very well restored. Guides appointed by the MP Govt Tourism are well informed and charge ₹611 for about an hour of guided tour. The Stupas of Sanchi appear on the 200 Indian Rupee currency note.

attractions.name: Archaeological Museum
attractions.description: They have some wonderful artifacts there. The history and historical artifacts from places around Sanchi. Metal-tools and beautiful sculptures as old as 2000 years make you think about that era. The museum also showcases the history and revival of this place.

attractions.name: Rohtang Pass
attractions.description: At an altitude of 3979 m (13,050 ft) above sea level, this is another adventure tourist site where it can be cold even on a summer day. It is the highest point on the Manali-Keylong road and provides a wide panoramic view of mountains rising far above clouds, which is truly breath-taking. Close by is a small lake called Dassaur Lake. Beas Kund, the source of river Beas, is also nearby. In winter, the road of Rothang Pass is closed.The road to Rohtang Pass is closed at Manali bridge on all Tuesdays between 9AM-6PM for carrying out road widening work & repairs. If you are able to leave early, before 09:00, you can avoid the traffic rush (found on all other days) and have Rohtang Pass to yourself (well almost!). Flip side is to be prepared for stoppages (extending up to a few hours) on the return trip as the road is blocked off where repair works are progressed.If you are driving up, be prepared for the rough broken roads at many places, sheer blind turns and tight hairpin bends, which ca

attractions.name: Beas Kund
attractions.description: An igloo-shaped temple, on top has a spring which is the origin of River Beas.

attractions.name: Fun park
attractions.description: Near the Hadimba Temple

attractions.name: Hidimba Temple
attractions.description: It is an ancient cave temple dedicated to Hidimbi Devi, who was a character in the Indian epic, Mahābhārata. The temple is surrounded by a cedar forest at the foot of the Himālayas. The sanctuary is built over a huge rock jutting out of the ground, which was worshipped as an image of the deity. The structure was built in the year 1553.

attractions.name: Maa Sharvari Temple
attractions.description: This temple is represented as Kuldevi of the kings of Kullu in early times and is worshipped as a manifestation of Durga, and image of the goddess is also enshrined here. The divinity is popularly worshipped throughout the region during the festivals and the Goddess is transported to Kullu to visit the Lord Raghunathji during Dussehra festival. This temple is on the top of above the Shaminallah village, which is around 5 km from Manali, across the Beas river on the left bank on the way to Naggar Castle.

attractions.name: Monasteries
attractions.description: Manali is known for its shiny gompas or Buddhist monasteries. These are maintained by donations from the local community and by the sale of hand-woven carpets in the temple workshops.

attractions.name: Museum of Himachal Culture & Folk Art
attractions.description: The museum is situated on a two minutes walk from the Hadimba Devi Temple in Utopia Complex. The museum is a unique and extraordinary collection of unknown and rare antiques of the state. It demonstrates the almost extinct articles that clearly display the forgotten culture, art and handicraft of Himachal Pradesh. The museum has 18 galleries in it which display antiques from different aspects of cultural life of people of Himachal Pradesh.

attractions.name: Old Manali
attractions.description: 3 km northwest of Manali is Old Manali, famous for its orchards and old guesthouses. There is ruined fort here by the name of Manaligarh. There is also the Manu Maharishi Temple, dedicated to sage Manu.

attractions.name: Rahala waterfalls
attractions.description: About 16 km from Manali at the start of the climb to the Rohtang Pass, are the beautiful Rahalla Falls at an altitude of 2,501 m.

attractions.name: Rozy Falls
attractions.description: On the way to Rohtang amazing water fall worth seeing. this water fall looks amazing between the high hills.

attractions.name: Solang Valley
attractions.description: Popularly known as Snow Point, Solang Valley is 13 km northwest of Manali and famous for its 300-m ski lift. The Ski Lift ticket is ₹400 per head. It is a picturesque spot and offers splendid views of glaciers and the snow-capped mountains. Jagatsukh, the former capital of Manali, is also an important spot.

attractions.name: Vashist Hot Water Springs and Temple
attractions.description: Around 3 km from Manali, across the Beas river is Vashist, a small village with natural sulphur springs. Modern bathhouses, with Turkish-style showers, have the hot water piped into them for the convenience of the visitors who come here to benefit from the medicinal properties. Vaishisht, also boasts a pair of old stone temples, opposite each other above the main square. Dedicated to the local patron saint Vashista, the smaller of the two opens on to a partially covered courtyard, and is adorned with elaborate woodcarvings. Those lining the interior of the shrine, blackened by years of oil-lamp and incense smoke, are particularly fine. The temple tanks are underground hot-water/sulfur springs. Be wary of hanging up your trousers or bags on the hooks provided, pickpocketing is a daily occurrence. Hand over your wallet to a trusted person for safekeeping before you enter the springs for a bath.

attractions.name: Beautiful Log Hut Area and Club house
attractions.description: Both these places especially log hut area have some good hotels to stay.

attractions.name: The Manali Gompa
attractions.description: Manali Gompa was built in 1960. It is one of the most important places for Buddhists. Buddhists come to this place from Ladakh, Tibet, Spiti, Lahul and Kinnaur. Manali Gompa is world famous for a large statue of Buddha and for its wall paintings.

attractions.name: Naggar
attractions.description: The Castle, Roerich House and Art gallery are places to see. Moonlight dinner on the balcony of Hotel Castle restaurant is worth experiencing, with the lovely sight of twinkling lights below in the Beas valley. Bijli Mahadev temple, about 20 km from Naggar, is also worth visiting.

attractions.name: Jana Falls
attractions.description: 15 km from Naggar and 35 km from Manali, at Zana Village, beautiful Water Fall is worth visiting. The valley provides amazing views. There is one water fall on the road side and two other water falls which are not much explored by tourists and are amazing. Moreover traditional Himachali food is available here at small hut like shops.

attractions.name: Nehru Kund
attractions.description: Nehru Kund is around 6 km from Manali. It is one of the natural springs of natural water in India. Nehru Kund is named after the late Prime Minister Jawar Lal Nehru. Nehru used to drink water from this Kund, while his journey to Manali. Nehru Kund is on the Manali-Keylong road, about 6 km from Manali. It is understood that a landslide has wiped out this spring.

restaurants.name: Apple Blossoms
restaurants.description: Savour a Himachali menu as well as delectable Indian, European, oriental cuisines.

restaurants.name: Blue Elephant Cafe
restaurants.description: It is a small eatery with good Indian and Western spread close to the bridge on the Beas River. You get the option of sitting and enjoying the food right next to the river gushing by. Try out the freshly made parathas, bruschettas, omelettes and traditional Indian tea.

restaurants.name: Bob Dylan's Cafe
restaurants.description: Serves cookies, sandwiches, etc., with a complimentary movie theatre offering around 100 films alongside Bob Dylan's music.

restaurants.name: Cafe Bella Vista
restaurants.description: A small Spanish-style café with 2 small & 2 cottage rooms available for stay. Serves fresh brick-oven pizzas & Italian.

restaurants.name: Cafe m 1947
restaurants.description: The 1st music cafe in Old Manali (near the bridge), on the banks of the River Manalsu. Cuisines from all around the globe and known for its dishes like the "Burger of Bodom", "UFO", and "The Terminator". Travelers can also play instruments in rhythm with the Voice of the River, and there are unplugged concerts and parties held now and then.

restaurants.name: Cafe Zeppelinn
restaurants.description: The last cafe once you leave Manali and are heading towards Rohtang Pass. It is run by young enterpreneurs for their love of life in the mountains and music. They serve good pizzas, pastas, sandwiches and momos. They also play excellent rock music from the 1960s and 1970s. Most paragliders will land at their cafe and many enjoy their services while waiting for their friends or families to pick them up.

restaurants.name: Chawlas Square
restaurants.description: Delicious north Indian and Mughlai food.

restaurants.name: Chopsticks
restaurants.description: Really good Tibetan food.

restaurants.name: Dawat Restaurant
restaurants.description: A well-decorated, in-house, multi-cuisine restaurant that offers Indian, Mughlai and Chinese delicacies.

restaurants.name: Drifters' Inn and Cafe
restaurants.description: This has great food, Wi-Fi internet and friendly atmosphere.

restaurants.name: Il Forno
restaurants.description: Italian pizzas prepared by an Italian cook.

restaurants.name: Green Forest cafe
restaurants.description: It is also a very popular destination for both locals and foreigners. It serves Tibetan soups, veggie dumplings and other sandwiches and snacks.

attractions.name: Allen Forest Zoo
attractions.description: Biggest park in Kanpur City. This is the second best zoo in UP and third biggest zoo in India. Greenery and vastness of the zoo will capture any visitors attention. The natural surroundings in which animals are kept is a nice change from the caged variety that you see around other zoos.

attractions.name: Ganga Barrage
attractions.description: A dam built across Ganges River near Old Kanpur. Contains Boating Club.

attractions.name: Gora Cemetery
attractions.description: A cemetery of British militants near Civil Lines.

attractions.name: ISCKON Temple
attractions.description: It is a Radha Krishna temple on Mainawati Marg, Bithoor Road. There is also a restaurant named Govinda's.

attractions.name: Kanpur Sangrahalaya
attractions.description: A museum established by Britishers. It exhibits old pictures, books, items and many other things.

attractions.name: Kanpur Memorial Church
attractions.description: A church established by Britishers. It exhibits old fountains, books, items and many other things.

attractions.name: Massacre Ghat
attractions.description: Site of the Cawnpore massacre during the Indian Mutiny/War of Independence/Rebellion of 1857. The circular ridge of the well where the bodies of women and children were deposited is still visible and prominent figure of the rebel forces, Tantya Tope, is represented at the park in statue form.

attractions.name: Nana Rao Park
attractions.description: Site of the Cawnpore massacre during the Indian Mutiny/War of Independence/Rebellion of 1857. The circular ridge of the well where the bodies of women and children were deposited is still visible and prominent figure of the Rebel forces, Tantya Tope, is represented at the park in statue form.
attractions.address: Mall Rd, Phool Bagh Chauraha, Phool Bagh, Civil Lines

attractions.name: Shri Radha Krishna Temple
attractions.description: Wonderful piece of architecture and art and you must see this monument if you visit Kanpur. The Temple has statues of Lord Krishna, Lord Shiva, Lord Hanuman, Lord Vishnu, and Lord Rama. The illuminated towers of the temple can be seen from quite a distance at night. On Sundays, it is usually very crowded at summers as people try to get some relief from the high temperatures in the greenery and openness of the temple premises.

attractions.name: Vaisno Devi Mandir
attractions.description: Hindu temple.

attractions.name: Harcourt Butler Technological Institute
attractions.description: This is a premier engineering college in the region. This is the oldest engineering college of North India, after Roorkee. It was established in 1921 by the then Governor of United Province (now Uttar Pradesh) Sir Harcourt Butler. It has a sprawling 280 acres lush green campus having almost all the branches of engineering and Chemical-Technology.

attractions.name: Indian Institute of Technology
attractions.description: Campus in an isolated place with greenery and calm environment.

attractions.name: Bithoor
attractions.description: This is a popular getaway from Kanpur. This is a riverside of Holy Ganges river. Do take a boat ride across the river. There are no active lifeguards at this place so be cautious about swimming.

attractions.name: Sports Village
attractions.description: Amusement park.

attractions.name: Ekta Park
attractions.description: Amusement park.

attractions.name: Blue World Theme Park
attractions.description: Amusement park.

attractions.name: Golf Club
attractions.description: Play golf every morning by joining club.

attractions.name: Mahatma Gandhi park
attractions.description: Do boating at Mahatma Gandhi park.

attractions.name: Moti Jheel
attractions.description: Literally meaning "Pearl Lake", Moti Jheel is an artificial lake created during the British Raj. Boating and morning walks are popular lacustrine activities.

attractions.name: Rave moti
attractions.description: Watch movies at Rave moti, Rave 3 and Zsquare mall.

attractions.name: Jungle Water Park
attractions.description: Amusement park.

attractions.name: Micky House
attractions.description: Amusement park.

restaurants.name: Aromas
restaurants.description: A fast food point.

restaurants.name: Baba biryani
restaurants.description: Biryani.

restaurants.name: Banarsi ke ladoo
restaurants.description: Serves tasty boondi ladoos and has grown from a small shop into a huge store with lots of branches all over the city. The sweet store always has a huge line outside it during all festivities, where the ladoos need to be booked in advanced. Its ladoos have been export to America also.

restaurants.name: Ghosh Misthan Bhandar
restaurants.description: Among the famous sweets in Kanpur are rasgolla from this shop.

restaurants.name: Hanuman Chat
restaurants.description: Chat

restaurants.name: Hathras
restaurants.description: Chat.

restaurants.name: Makhan Singh
restaurants.description: Biryani.

restaurants.name: Peru
restaurants.description: Biryani.

restaurants.name: Rakesh Biryani
restaurants.description: A small standing-only place near the Parade Chauraha that serves a mouthwatering Chicken Biryani. This place does not cater to vegetarians.

restaurants.name: Ram Mishthan Bhandar
restaurants.description: A famous sweet shop offering varieties of mouth watering sweets and snacks and its "Peda" is very famous around the globe.

restaurants.name: Shanker
restaurants.description: Chat.

restaurants.name: Thaggu ke Ladu
restaurants.description: This is a small shop. Specialty of this shop are ladoos (balls of dried milk) and ice cream. Although high in calories, ladoos are very delicious. Bunty & Babli was also shot here.

attractions.name: Atal Setu
attractions.description: India's longest sea bridge, also known as Mumbai Trans-Harbour Link (MTHL). Named after former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, the bridge connects Sewri in Mumbai to Nhava Sheva in Navi Mumbai, across the Mumbai Harbour.

attractions.name: Mango Garden
attractions.description: Mango Garden, a must-visit place for couples and children. It is a small garden for almost all age group people.

attractions.name: Mini seashore, Juhu Chowpatty
attractions.description: Boating, toy train and lot of fun, bhel puri, pani puri, gola etc.

attractions.name: Parsik Hill
attractions.description: A very cool place on hilltop. People prefer to come here for morning and evening walk. Youngsters come here to have fun and just chill out. It is closed most of the times in the rainy season because of the landslide. A must to visit this place in evening hours if you are around. It is best to visit this place when the monsoon just starts. During this time there is an enchanting dew and also a slow waterfall often called the Pandavakhada waterfall.

attractions.name: Rajiv Gandhi Maidan
attractions.description: Lots of temples for doing Pooja and meditiation, and a good trek.

attractions.name: Rain Tree Marg
attractions.description: Has beautiful views of Navi Mumbai

attractions.name: Sarovar Vihar Garden
attractions.description: Like a second marine drive, provides a beautiful view of the sea, a drive from Vashi via the Palm Beach Road ends at Belapur

attractions.name: Seven Wonders
attractions.description: Park for all ages, it has the Seven Wonder statues. It is a huge park with joy rides. Water pool and fountains to view. Fruit shape huts to seat and take photos. Cool hang out with kids.

attractions.name: Pandavkada Falls
attractions.description: Monsoon tourist attraction for people from far and wide. Authorities are strict in not allowing people to visit this place in monsoon on account of accidental deaths in the waterfall.

attractions.name: Utsav Chowk
attractions.description: One of the most famous landmarks in the area and it stands out for its eye catching architecture which is a humble reflection of the Roman and Greek architecture.

attractions.name: Belapur Fort ruins
attractions.description: The fort was built by the Siddis of Janjira. It was later conquered by the Portuguese, and then Marathas. In the early 19th century, the fort was captured by the British. The deliberate damage wrought led to a decline in the strategic importance of the fort.

attractions.name: Dronagiri Fort
attractions.description: The ruins of the fortification are seen on the fort. There is a church Nossa Senhora da Penha in good condition, but without any idol or inscription. The church is in the inner fortification. The main gate to the fort is situated on the south of the church 50 m away. The arch of the gate is broken, yet the guards rooms are in good condition. The Ganapati carved on the key stone is placed in one of the guard room. From the main gate a path way leads south to the Village Karanja. In between a Vetal mandir in ruined state is located. The pathway starting from the back of the Vetal mandie leads to large water tank in good condition situated among the forest. The fort is accessible in all seasons. The trek to the fort is simple and safe. Being close to Uran and Karanja, the fort was strategic importance since old times. The entire hill is densely covered with forest.

attractions.name: Central Park
attractions.description: The project of Central Park is to make a public park with Navi Mumbai's ethos reflected into the future. It is under construction but is open to public. The large amphitheatre has hosted many public shows. An ISKCON temple is attached to this park. To the west of this park is Pandav Kada waterfall and CIDCO developed golf course.

attractions.name: DY Patil Stadium
attractions.description: The cricket stadium in the Navi Mumbai area hosts several international cricket matches and domestic championships such as the Mumbai T20 league and Times Cricket Shield. Wankhede matches in the Indian Premier League as well as Womens Premier League have been played at the stadium. The stadium also hosts international cricket tournaments and concerts.

attractions.name: Rajiv Gandhi Joggers Park
attractions.description: A hot-spot for joggers of all ages

attractions.name: Sagar Vihar
attractions.description: A cool place to chill out with friends; a must to visit during evening hours.

restaurants.name: Bhagat Tarachand
restaurants.description: Pure veg restaurant.

restaurants.name: Flavours
restaurants.description: Intercontinental cuisine. You can sit at the counter and enjoy your drinks (including the Bartender's Special).

restaurants.name: Hot Cross Cafe
restaurants.description: A very relaxing coffee shop where they serve a variety of hukka (sheesha) at a very minimal rate. One of the best places in Navi Mumbai for hukka and mouth watering and fresh pastries.

restaurants.name: Hotel Ruchi
restaurants.description: Possibly the best Keralite food you can find in the city. The restaurant itself is pretty small and unnoticeable but if you notice it, don't miss it. Try the Kerala Parotha with Chicken Masala and the idiyaappam and appams for breakfast

restaurants.name: Jaslok
restaurants.description: All sorts of snacks and sweets. Pani Puri, Vada Pav and Rasmalai, Jamun are the delicious items.

restaurants.name: Nanumal Bhojraj
restaurants.description: Damn good restaurant for Sindhi and Punjabi food.

restaurants.name: Navaratna
restaurants.description: One of the oldest restaurants in Vashi. It serves great food in the traditional Udipi style.

restaurants.name: Sri Krishna
restaurants.description: Good vegetarian food. Great watermelon juice! Home delivery available. Try the gadbad ice cream.

restaurants.name: Tunga
restaurants.description: Good place to eat. Excellent ghee chapaties.

restaurants.name: Vasundhara
restaurants.description: Pure veg restaurant.

restaurants.name: Viscious circle
restaurants.description: Mouth watering kebabs and non veg dishes, good ambience, drinks and a large projector screen.

restaurants.name: Gupta's
restaurants.description: Great range of toast sandwiches And pizzas.

attractions.name: Kalwa Naka
attractions.description: A historical landmark and historically a meetup place, still used as a meetup spot today.

attractions.name: Masunda Lake
attractions.description: The lake is home to a small island with a Shiv temple on it and also a Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Statue behind it. It is one of the biggest lakes and ideal places to visit in Thane at night. This lake is situated just beside the famous drama theatre Gadkari Rangayatan. The lake also offers recreational activities like boating. Also, it offers people shops to buy fish (fish tanks) for home decoration. There are many restaurants and food stalls facing Talavpali Lake.

attractions.name: Shri Kopineshwar Mandir
attractions.description: It is one of the oldest temples in Thane. It was reconstructed by Chimajji Appa around 1750 AD.

attractions.name: St. John the Baptist Church
attractions.description: This church is over 400 years old. St. John the Baptist Church is adjacent to St. John the Baptist High School and Junior College.

attractions.name: Upvan Lake
attractions.description: It is known for hosting the Sanskruti Arts Festival. Here one can also view thousands of Ganpati idols which are brought here for immersion on the final day of Ganeshotsav.

attractions.name: Dadoji Kondadev Stadium
attractions.description: A sports stadium used mostly for training. Its main ground has been built for cricket with an in-built six-lane running track for athletes. The complex also includes 5 badminton courts, a gym, a table tennis hall, 2 squash courts, a billiards room, a rummy room, a hall, a bar room, and a canteen.

attractions.name: Suraj Water Park
attractions.description: An excellent water recreation paradise which appeals to people belonging to all age groups. Spread over 11 acres. Suraj Water Park is definitely an ultimate and out-of-the-world source of entertainment.

attractions.name: Tikuji-Ni-Wadi
attractions.description: A popular destination for picnicking families, known for its watersports, go-karting and other rides you'd find at amusement parks. The go-karting track isn't very good though. Additionally, there is a Shiva temple and marriage halls as a part of the resort. The lunch is fabulous, though fully vegetarian. You will also need to buy lunch for ₹180 as you can't carry any edible stuff in from outside.

restaurants.name: Amruta Restaurant
restaurants.description: Amazing Paav Bhaji. Will surely make you lick your fingers.

restaurants.name: BBQ Nation
restaurants.description: Famous for Veg and Non-Veg Grill. Very nice place to be with family. Good ambience.
restaurants.address: Eastern Express highway service road, near new RTO, Green Road

restaurants.name: Dilip Pani Puri
restaurants.description: Amazing Sindhi Pani Puri and chat.

restaurants.name: Hotel Amantran
restaurants.description: Famous for Maharashtrian food, spicy and tasty menus with very good service.

restaurants.name: Mahesh Lunch Home
restaurants.description: Famous for good sea food. Ideal place for non-veg lovers. Good ambience.

restaurants.name: Maria Family Restaurant
restaurants.description: Maria Family Restaurant is one of the best family restaurant in thane. It is located at Majiwada junction, Having ample space of valet parking. Hotel is especially for Chinese, Indian & Punjabi dishes. There is different kitchen for Veg & Non Veg Food, & main attraction of children i.e. huge Fish Tank.

restaurants.name: R-Mall
restaurants.description: opened

restaurants.name: Spices and Sauces, Restaurant

attractions.name: Alandi
attractions.description: The resting place of the 13th century Marathi saint Sant Dnyaneshwar. His devotees believe that he is still alive. A temple complex was built at Dnyaneshwar's samadhi and is visited by pilgrims, especially those of the Varkari sect.

attractions.name: Ghorawadi Caves
attractions.description: A cave with carvings and statues of Buddhist and Hindu deities.

attractions.name: Savitribai Phule Pune University
attractions.description: The site of Pune University was the official residence of the Governor of Bombay during the monsoon season. The campus features mansions built in Italian-Gothic style. A 300-m-high tower beckons to all these who come here in the pursuit of higher education. It is one of the oldest universities in India.

attractions.name: Indori Fort
attractions.description: A fort built by Sarsenapati Khandojirao Yesajirao Dabhade in 1720-21. The fort also has a mint building inside the fort which is in shambles. The entrance gate is in good condition. The fort has 9 bastions which are well connected by a fortification wall. The walls of the fort are high made of basalt rock with brickwork at the top. There is a temple of Kadjai inside the fort.

attractions.name: Aga Khan Palace
attractions.description: This historical landmark's architecture features Italian arches, salons, suites and spacious lawns. During the 1942 Quit India Movement, the British interned Mahatma Gandhi and his wife Kasturba Gandhi here. The palace belonged to Aga Khan, prince and head of the Khoja sect, who later donated the palace to erect a memorial dedicated to Mahatma Gandhi and his wife. Must see is an exhibition of very rare black-and-white photos and paintings from various epochs in the freedom movement, but descriptions are sparse so it helps if you already have background to the story. Also worth seeing is the Samadhi of Kasturba Gandhi in the backyard.

attractions.name: Chapekar Wada
attractions.description: The house of the Chapekar brothers, two Indian revolutionaries in the British period, now converted to a museum.

attractions.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Museum of Indian History
attractions.description: The museum contains various exhibits on Indian history. It was founded by French author François Gautier.

attractions.name: Pimpri Chinchwad Science Park
attractions.description: A science centre housing a museum, an art gallery, an auditorium, an amphitheatre and a planetarium.

attractions.name: Japalouppe Equestrian Centre
attractions.description: Punes Premier Riding school, Japalouppe is spread out over a picturesque 19 acres, with a team of 60 horses catering to a wide skill set of riders, from basic trotting and school work to advanced jumping and dressage.
attractions.address: Somatne Ohata, Mumbai Pune highway, talegaon Dabhade

attractions.name: Pune University Heritage Tour
attractions.description: The curated walk takes visitors inside the main building complex, which was built in 1871 and served as the summer residence of the Governor of Bombay. Building was designed by James Trubshaw and was modeled in lines of Prince Albert’s Osborne House on the Isle of Wight, while the bell tower was inspired by Giotto’s Bell Tower in Florence, Italy. The interior consisted of a grand ballroom which has been converted into an auditorium. The dining room today serves as a seminar room. In spite of the adoptive reuse the interior is mostly kept unchanged and still contains the antique furniture and chandeliers. The building also houses a museum with exhibits from history, geology and anthropology. Weapons from the 19th-century Maratha armory are also on display.The most interesting part of the Pune University heritage tour is a 300-foot-long underground tunnel that once connected the kitchen. Note: The notice appears on the Savitribai Phule Pune University website on Friday and there is no ne

attractions.name: Maharashtra Cricket Association Stadium
attractions.description: It hosts both one-day internationals and test matches with a seating capacity of 37,000 spectators. It serves as the home stadium for the Maharashtra cricket team, as well as the IPL team Pune Warriors.

attractions.name: PCMC Hockey Stadium
attractions.description: A field hockey stadium.

restaurants.name: Vasu Vada Pav

restaurants.name: Barberque Nation
restaurants.description: Offers a vast & delicious variety of concept dining menus. Really worth paying for, especially for the unlimited servings of prawns, crabs, chicken, mutton, fish and also equally delicious Veg food. Rotate skewered dishes yourself with a grill built into the table. Good 8-10 variety of desserts to finish your meal.

Nehru Rose Garden

restaurants.name: Jhandu Di Hatti
restaurants.description: A famous poorie shop in Chaura Bazar.

attractions.name: Bharat Ratna Dr. M.G.R New Bus Stand
attractions.description: The bus stand is located in Veinthankulam. It has regular bus services to nearby cities like Tenkasi, Tiruchendur, Thoothukudi, Kanniyakumari, Nagercoil, Kovilpatti as well as to Major cities of Tamil Nadu and its neighbouring states like Madurai, Chennai, Tiruchirappalli, Coimbatore, Bangalore, Alappuzha, Rameswaram, Velankanni , Tirupathi etc.

attractions.name: Junction Periyar Bus Stand
attractions.description: The bus stand serves as terminal to Local buses which run within the city. The bus stand is under re-modelling now.

attractions.name: Palayamkottai Bus Stand
attractions.description: The bus stand, which is loocated in Palayamkottai, also serves as terminal for local buses.

attractions.name: Arulmigu Nellaiyappar Sametha Arultharum Gandhimathi Amman Temple
attractions.description: Arulmigu Nellaiappar - Ganthimathi Temple is one of the oldest and biggest Shiva temple in Tamil Nadu. It is situated in the heart of Tirunelveli. It is famous for its musical pillars, 1000-Pillars Mandapam and Thamira Sabai . The original complex is believed to have been built by Pandyas, while the present masonry structure was added by Cholas, Pallavas, Cheras, and Madurai Nayaks. In modern times, the temple is maintained and adminIstered by the Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Department of the Government of Tamil Nadu.The Nellaiappar Temple is bigger than the Madurai Meenakshi Amman Temple, though the latter is more famous owing to its historical importance.

attractions.name: Arulmigu Subramaniya Swami Temple, Kurukkuthurai
attractions.description: The historic temple, which was built by Nayakas, is located in the banks of river Thamirabarani. Whenever the water level rises in Thamirabarani river due to floods, the temple gets submerged in the river, yet, it is still beautiful and withstands floods.

restaurants.name: Iruttu Kadai
restaurants.description: Iruttu kadai, a sweet stall has got its name because the shop opens at 5 P.M in the evening and operates with only 1 or 2 yellow electric bulbs (iruttu kadai translates to dark shop). The halwa (a sweet) from this place is famous all over the country and it's the first thing that comes to mind when you utter the city name. It is located opposite to the Nellaiappar temple and is almost always crowded. The original iruttu kadai is located opposite to the nellaiappar temple. There are no other branches in anywhere in the world.

attractions.description: A very peaceful place.

attractions.description: A must see, with -high Shivaling.

attractions.name: Raja Naher Singh Palace
attractions.description: A palace built in the 18th and 19th centuries. Now partially converted to a motel and restaurant.

attractions.name: Triveni Hanuman Mandir
attractions.description: At , this is supposed to be one of the biggest statues of Lord Hanuman in India. There is a temple adjacent to the statue. This temple is very old and hundreds of devotees come here on Tuesday and Saturday. The statue took about 9 years to build.

restaurants.name: Red Chilli
restaurants.description: Chinese fast food joint which provides exceptionally tasty fast foods like Momos, Crispy Chilli Chicken and Hong Kong Noodles. The Chicken Momos are a speciality.

restaurants.name: More Than Paranthas

restaurants.name: Pind-Balluchi
restaurants.description: A cool place for OK food, a village scene ambience, a dance floor in "Mudra" the "discotheque", and party place. The ice-cream counter stocks some uncommon flavours, for example paan (betel leaf).

restaurants.name: Chickenette
restaurants.description: Chickenette has one of the hottest dishes ever, which goes by the name "Banzaara Tikka". Try it and everything else will pale — nay, bland — in comparison. Their paneer tikka is legendary.
restaurants.address: Sector-15 Market, opposite Mother Dairy kiosk

restaurants.name: SRS Mall, Sec 12
restaurants.description: Get some whacky "paans" (assorted spices, condiments etc. wrapped in betel leaves). Varieties range from Chocolate Paan to Rose-Paan to the winter favourite, Kesar-Badaam Paan. For the unadventurous, the simple meetha-paan will suffice.

attractions.name: Durgadi Fort
attractions.description: A fort Which was built by Shivaji Maharaj near Ganesh Ghat at Kalyan, on the Ulhas river bank. Built in Under the Marathas reign (1760-72), a new gate about 70m to the south of the Ganesh gate was opened near the mansion of Ramji Mahadeo Biwalkar. Also here is the 'Eidga' Mosque.
attractions.address: Kalyan-Ahmednagar Hwy, Annabhau Sathe Nagar, Tilak Nagar

attractions.name: Kala Talav
attractions.description: A famous & historical lake.

attractions.name: Lonad Caves & ancient Sun Temple
attractions.description: Caves as old as the ones at Ajanta and Ellora, on a hill near Lonad village. The Sun Temple is in the village.

restaurants.name: Hotel Relish
restaurants.description: Hotel Relish is a family restaurant and bar serving Indian, Chinese, Punjabi & Mughlai dishes.

restaurants.name: Gurudev Hotel
restaurants.description: AC/non AC

restaurants.name: Kokan King Family Garden Restaurant & Bar
restaurants.description: Konkan King also has a resort and water park to chill out with your family and friends. When it's the season, you can enjoy boating with a mini-train for your children, bird sanctuary and lots of amusement games. Specialists in Chicken Handi and fresh seafood. Grab some vadapavs late in the night till the early morning just outside the eastern side of the railway station.

restaurants.name: Metro Junction Mall
restaurants.description: Fast foody. 3rd level of mall is reserved for food court.

restaurants.name: Prasad Hotel
restaurants.description: 3½ star rated with high brand infrastructure and hospitality, service. Prasad hotel is near Katemanivli. Kolhapuri bhaji is most tasty food served here.

restaurants.name: Relax Garden NX
restaurants.description: This is one of the best hotels in town for dinner. 4 km away from the station.

attractions.name: Basilica of Our Lady of Graces
attractions.description: Basilica of Our Lady of Graces, also known as Churches among the Churches, is dedicated to Virgin Mary. The Church was built by Begum Samru, a Nautch girl of 14 who married a European mercenary soldier Walter Reinhardt Sombre. Samru converted to Roman Catholicism in 1781 and adopted the name Joanna Nobilis. She is regarded as the only Catholic ruler in India, and ruled the Principality of Sardhana in 18th and 19th century. The church is the largest in North India.

attractions.name: Mustafa Castle
attractions.description: An edifice built by Nawab Mohammad Ishak Khan in memory of his father Nawab Mustafa Khan Shefta, a poet and critic.

attractions.name: St. John's Church
attractions.description: The oldest garrison church in Northern India, built from 1819 to 1822. Its cemetery contains graves of David Ochterlony and Rollo Gillespie.

attractions.name: Arnala Fort
attractions.description: A fort on an island off Vasai-Virar. The main entrance of the fort faces approximately north. The solid stone doorway is adorned with pictures of tigers and elephants. There is a large octagonal fresh water reservoir inside the fort. Within its walls, are also the temples of Ambakeshwar, Bhavani and Shiva as well as dargahs (tombs) of Shah Ali and Hajji Ali.

attractions.name: Hedavde Mahalaxmi Temple
attractions.description: Very powerful Hindu temple founded by great astrologer, Param Pujya Dadasaheb Hate of Vasai.

attractions.name: Tungareshwar Temple
attractions.description: A Shiva temple in a strangely beautiful garden. In the dome, a trident (triśul) stands impressively against the horizon. The temple room was small but beautifully decorated in Minimalistic works of colourful glass. On one corner of the room there's a small temple of Devi. In the centre, there is the main Shivalinga with a Hug serpent in brass coiled around it. A brass post hangs above and water trickling down from it drop by drop over the linga. The temple also has some symbols of sacred geometry and the temple is designed as per Vastu Shastra.

attractions.name: Tungareshwar Wildlife Sanctuary
attractions.description: A migration corridor between Sanjay Gandhi National Park and Tansa Wildlife Sanctuary. It rises to about above sea level, making it a very popular destination for trekkers. Many bird walks, nature trails by wildlife professionals from around Mumbai and Vasai-Virar are conducted here. The terrain is a mix of rocky surface and flatland intermittently. Trekkers must make sure you carry along medical kit, and really good amount of water with you. Highly recommended to wear full sleeves clothes to avoid any bites, wounds, tans. Carrying a cap and sunglasses is a must to protect you from the harsh heat, as this route has less shade. There are two ways you can reach the summit of the Tungareshwar WLS, one being from Vasai Road West which starts from the main gate itself, the other one can be trekked from the region of Vajreshwari.

attractions.name: Vasai Fort
attractions.description: Portuguese mariners exploring the north Konkan Coast discovered the Arab Sultanate of Khambhat or Cambay, built or renovated or expanded the fort in the early 1400s and attacked it in a failed effort to seize it. The ramparts overlook what is alternatively called Vasai Creek and Bhayander Creek and are almost complete, though overgrown by vegetation. Several watchtowers still stand, with safe staircases leading up. The Portuguese buildings inside the fort are in ruins, although there are enough standing walls to give a good idea of the floor plans of these structures. Some have well-preserved façades. In particular, many of the arches have weathered the years remarkably well. They are usually decorated with carved stones, some weathered beyond recognition, others still displaying sharp chisel marks. Three chapels inside the fort are still recognisable. They have façades typical of 17th-century Portuguese churches. The southernmost of these has a well-preserved barrel-vaulted ceiling. I

attractions.name: Central Institute of Mining and Fuel Research
attractions.description: CIMFR, Dhanbad is one of the national laboratories of Council of Scientific and Industrial Research, Government of India. This laboratory was established in 1956 for carrying out research and development work in the field of mining and related subjects to make mining safe, productive, reduce its environmental impact and economical as well as reduce health hazards to miners and environmental pollution and degradation created due to mining and associated industrial activities.

attractions.name: Indian Institute of Technology
attractions.description: An institute of national importance. It was established in 1926, and has one of the most beautiful engineering campuses in the country.

attractions.name: Chark Khurd
attractions.description: The village, which is about 10 km from Tundi on the Dhanbad-Govindpur -Giridih Road, is noted for its hot spring.

attractions.name: Chati Gobindpur
attractions.description: The village is in Govindpur development block, contains two ancient pillars which are locally associated with Emperor Asoka and the Afghan Chief Sher Shah.

attractions.name: Gopalpur
attractions.description: The village lies in Nirsa-cum-Chirkunda development block. It contains an ancient pillar said to date back to the time of Emperor Asoka. There is also a large stone image said to be of Asoka.

attractions.name: Jhinjhipahari
attractions.description: The village is in Baghmara development block. It is said that an ancient temple of Lord Shiva was found when the mines here were being worked.

attractions.name: Lilori Sthan
attractions.description: It is famous for Goddess Kali temple, it is also one of the devipeth.

attractions.name: Maithon Dam
attractions.description: Maithon Dam is the biggest Dam of Damodar Valley Corporation. This dam has been built to control flood in the Barakar River. The reservoir of Maithon Dam is spread across 65 km². In the mid of this reservoir, there is an island. A rest house has been built on this island. Boating & fishing facilities are also available in this reservoir. There is a Deer park and Birds garden near this Dam these are also of a tourists importance.

attractions.name: Meva
attractions.description: The village is in Nirsa-cum-Chirkunda Block. It contains ancient pillars said to date back to the time of Emperor Ashoka. There is also a large stone image said to be of Ashoka.

attractions.name: Panchet Dam
attractions.description: This is the longest dam of Damodar Valley Corporation. Garh Panchakot beside the lake has lodging facilities.

attractions.name: Panrra
attractions.description: The village, which also lies in Nirsa-cum-Chirkunda Block, it said to have derived its name from the Pandavas. According to local legend the Pandavas spent some period of their exile in hiding at this place. The village contains an ancient temple of Lord Shiva known as Pandeweshar Mahadev. The temple is believed to have been constructed by Hindu King at a much later day.

attractions.name: Tetulia
attractions.description: Just near the Damodar River in the Dhanbad district, there is a spring of hot water.

attractions.name: Topchanchi
attractions.description: In Topchanchi, tourists can see an artificial lake that was excavated along the base of the slant of the Parasnath Hill in 1915. This lake was created to supply water to Jharia. Visitors can also go to Gomoh, which is 6 km from the Topchanchi Lake. Gomoh is the place where on 18th January 1941 Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose embarked on the train for his departure from India. To honour this event, a statue of Netaji has been set up in the Topchanchi market.

restaurants.name: Hotel Skylark - Flavours Restaurant
restaurants.description: Multicuisine restaurant, vegetarian food, non-vegetarian food, Jain food

restaurants.name: Take Home
restaurants.description: Veg and non-veg. Try Hyderabad Chicken Biryani(₹80).

attractions.name: Acharya Jagadish Chandra Bose Indian Botanic Garden
attractions.description: An extraordinary place of vivid nature under the smog filled sky of the city. You will value the silence that is only filled by some birds singing. The Great Banyan tree in the botanical garden boasts of having the largest canopy in the world. The British established the institution in 1786 as Indian Botanical Garden.

attractions.name: Howrah Bridge
attractions.description: Officially Rabindra Setu (রবীন্দ্র সেতু Robīndro Setu), the Howrah Bridge is one of the iconic bridges of West Bengal. See the Kolkata listing for details.

attractions.name: Kolkata West Gate
attractions.description: Based on the Brandenburg Gate in Berlin, the gate is an entrance to the Kolkata West International City (KWIC), a satellite township in Howrah developed by Indonesia's Ciputra Group.

attractions.name: Santragachi Jheel
attractions.description: A large lake next to Santragachi railway station. It attracts a lot of migratory birds in the winter months, particularly in December and January, impart because migratory birds are avoiding destinations like the lakes in Alipore Zoo, Kolkata. Birds like Saras Crane from North America and Australia, and many other local migratory birds such as Cotton Pygmy Goose, and Comb Duck, are spotted here during this season. The lake area is owned by South Eastern Railway, though the Forest Department of West Bengal also looks after the place. Efforts are made by local residents, Forest Department and Railways to improve the environment for the birds.

attractions.name: Statue of Enlightened Buddha
attractions.description: A pair of brass statues of the Buddha at Kona Expressway.

attractions.name: Vidyasagar Setu
attractions.description: The longest cable-stayed bridge in India and one of the longest in Asia, south/downstream of Howrah Bridge. See the Kolkata listing for details.

attractions.name: Rail Museum
attractions.description: A museum established in 2006 to display the history and heritage of railways in the eastern part of India with special focus on Howrah Station. The collection includes the first broad-gauge electric locomotive built in India, a WCM-5; a HPS-32 steam locomotive captured during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971; and the Indraprastha, claimed to be the oldest remaining Indian Railways shunting locomotive.

attractions.name: Bangeswar Mahadeb Temple
attractions.description: One of the most popular Shiva temples in Howrah, with the tallest four-headed statue of Shiva in Eastern India at . The Jalan family built this temple in 1952, and it has been a local pilgrimage site ever since. The tall Shiva statue, named "Bangeswar Mahadeb" (বঙ্গেশ্বর মহাদেব Baṅgeśbar Mahādeb, literally the "Lord of Bengal"), was later added in 2015 to spread the message of "Love Humanity". The replicas of the 12 Jyotirlingas of Hinduism are later added in the temple premises, including Kashi Vishwanath, Kedarnath and Somnath. Outside the temple, there's a viewing deck to enjoy the Hooghly River.

attractions.name: Bhot Bagan Math
attractions.description: The first Tibetan Buddhist temple on the plains of India. The temple was founded in 1776 by Puran Giri, the Indian representative of the third Panchen Lama of Tibet. The temple was later attacked by armed dacoits in 1795, and Puran Giri was killed while resisting it. The Math remains abandoned since 1905.

attractions.name: Howrah Maidan Idgah Masjid
attractions.description: The largest mosque in Howrah, with an adjacent eidgah (open-air enclosure reserved for Eid prayers). It sees crowd during the morning of Eid al-Fitr, as well as Eid al-Adha.

attractions.name: Belilious Park
attractions.description: An amusement park. Within the park, there is a pond and the trees around here provide greenery to the region. A marriage hall is also present here for marriage events. The Panchdeep Tower within the park is the tallest structure in Howrah.

attractions.name: Dumurjala Sports City
attractions.description: A sports complex with plays host to several prominent talent hunt contests and sports activities.

attractions.name: Howrah Planetarium and Astronomical Research Centre
attractions.description: A planetarium in Howrah with virtual tours of the night sky and cosmic shows in a specially perforated hemispherical dome. It is India's first 3D planetarium. A total of three shows are conducted a day in this planetarium to introduce visitors to the solar system. Visitors can also learn about important space discoveries and related information. Each show at planetarium is conducted for 25 minutes. Shows are available here in Bengali, English and Hindi.

attractions.name: Mahant Ghasi Memorial Museum
attractions.description: A small but well maintained museum with exhibits on the history of the state and an impressive collection of carvings, upstairs has a display of tribal artifacts and models. The museum ground has a beautiful open air restaurant where you can try interesting tribal food at street food prices, There is also a well equipped government tourist office, recommended.
attractions.address: Ghadi Chowk, Raj Bhawan Rd, Civil Lines

attractions.name: Vivekananda Sarovar
attractions.description: A large statue in the center of a somewhat shabby lake (under refurbishment). Built in honour of Swami Vivekanada who was chief disciple of the 19th-century Indian mystic Ramakrishna and is credited with introducing yoga and Vedanta to the western world. There are boat rides in the evening.

attractions.name: Aalnia Dam
attractions.description: (25 km) An archeological area with ancient Indian stone carvings.

attractions.name: Chambal Garden
attractions.description: This garden stretches along the banks of the river Chambal. It houses a pond with rare gharial and crocodiles, which can be crossed via a teetering suspension bridge. It also has enclosures for birds, rabbits and such. Right next to it is the unique Yatayat (traffic) park. It is a theme park; with miniature flyovers, speedbreakers, tunnels, buildings and such all used to showcase traffic rules.

attractions.name: Darrah Wildlife Sanctuary
attractions.description: (50 km) - One of 3 wildlife sanctuaries in Rajasthan with large tracts of forests and a variety of wildlife

attractions.name: Garh Palace
attractions.description: Palace and fort complex often visited by tourists.

attractions.name: Godawari Dham
attractions.description: It is a Hanuman temple at few km from Chambal garden.

attractions.name: Jag Mandir
attractions.description: Right in the center of the artificial Kishore Sagar tank (Lake Pichola) stands the beautiful red sandstone monument, Jagmandir.

attractions.name: Karneshawar Temple
attractions.description: A temple dedicated to God Shiva.

attractions.name: Khade Ganesh Ji Temple
attractions.description: Ganesh Temple (southern part of the city) owes its fame to its standing Ganesh, which is nowhere else to be found in India. Rangbadi Balaji temple is nearby.

attractions.name: Kota Barrage
attractions.description: A dam as part of the irrigation canal system on the river Chambal, this is a popular spot especially when the flood gates are let open to allow extra water to flow off.

attractions.name: Maharao Madho SIngh Museum
attractions.description: Named after Kota's first ruler, the museum has a spell-binding collection of miniature paintings, armory and sculptures. It remains closed on Fridays.

attractions.name: Sawan Phuhar Waterpark
attractions.description: It is the only waterpark in the Hadoti Region and houses the biggest pool in the city.

attractions.name: Boat Safari
attractions.description: Take a boat safari on the Chambal river and observe crocodiles at close quarters. It starts from Chambal Garden.

attractions.name: Gaiparnath Temple
attractions.description: A beautiful and ancient temple dedicated to Lord Shiva constructed more than 200 feet below ground level. The temple is constantly showered by a natural waterfall. The greenery and rocky cliffs around gives a fantastic view. A must visit. Caution : the place is usually deserted, hence avoid going alone. A group of 7 to 8 people would be fine, the more the better.

attractions.name: Chandramauleshwara Temple
attractions.description: 11th-century Shiva temple.

attractions.name: Nrupatunga Betta
attractions.description: promising panoramic view of the expanse of Hubli City- with in city,

attractions.name: Siddharodh Math
attractions.address: 3 km from Chennamma Circle on Karwar road

attractions.name: Eshwar Temple
attractions.address: Siddharooda Matt Road, Srinivas Nagar, Old Hubli

attractions.name: ISKCON Temple
attractions.description: Krishna temple, really relaxing place.

attractions.name: Shree Sai Mandir
attractions.description: Beautiful place to visit.

restaurants.name: Canara Hotel
restaurants.description: One of the best hotels for delicious South and North Indian delicacy

restaurants.name: The Hans Hotel
restaurants.description: Authentic cuisines of Indian, Continental and Chinese. Also, a great lounge bar.

restaurants.name: Al Taj
restaurants.description: Great Non Veg Food.

attractions.name: Sohna Lake
attractions.description: Sohna Lake is about 10 km from Gurgaon. It is best to visit after rainfall and during winters.

attractions.name: Vintage Camera Museum and Foundation
attractions.description: India's largest camera museum. One can visit from Tuesday-Saturday from 11AM-5PM only via appointments.

attractions.name: NeverEnuf Garden Railway
attractions.description: Miniature railway modelling project about 5 km off National Highway 8 through a bumpy road. A labour of love rather than a money grab, visits must be pre-registered by contacting through the details mentioned on their website. A great place to revel in the detailed world building or a leisurely family picnic spot during winters. Carry your own food, only light snacks are available on site.

attractions.name: Dronacharya Temple
attractions.description: A rare temple dedicated to the teacher Dronacharya in the Mahabharata epic.

attractions.name: Aravali Biodiversity Park
attractions.description: The park on the Aravalli Range includes a number of trails and a native plant nursery and interpretive displays at the entrance.

attractions.name: DT Cinemas
attractions.description: DT City Centre and Mega Mall. Tickets would cost you around ₹150 on weekdays and as much as ₹200 on a big opening on weekends. Late shows too last show starts around 11PM!

attractions.name: PVR
attractions.description: Sahara Mall (2 screens), Metropolitian Malls (9 screens), Ambience Mall (9 screens). Good thing is that there are lot of late shows the last show starts almost at midnight

attractions.name: Devi Art Foundation
attractions.description: The Devi Art Foundation is one of the first not-for-profit spaces dedicated to showcasing contemporary art from the Indian Subcontinent. It is envisioned as a space that will enable wider audiences to interact with cutting edge and experimental art works. The current exhibition, 'Where in the World' takes a look at the effects of globalization on contemporary Indian art and has 65 art-works by over 20 Indian artists. The Foundation is open to the public on all days except Monday, from 11AM-7PM.

attractions.name: Wet and wild resort
attractions.description: Chill down your summer heat, water games and sports are great fun. Don't forget to take you swim wear.

attractions.name: Sky Jumper Trampoline Park
attractions.description: An exciting place to be, especially for kids, with more than 100 trampolines connected with built-in rock climbing optional too.
attractions.address: ILD trade centre, Sohna Road, sector 47

attractions.name: Oyesters Amusement Park
attractions.description: Another good place to be to beat Gurugram's heat.

attractions.name: Tau Devi Lal Stadium
attractions.description: A multi-purpose sports complex hosting football and cricket matches.

restaurants.name: Bikanerwala
restaurants.description: Great ambience and assortment of Indian dishes like chole bhature, lassi, kulfi, dosa, Chinese food, pizza. Indian cuisine is good, only vegetarian food is available. Try their Alphonso ice-cream in summers a very exotically-packed ice-cream inside a mango!

restaurants.name: Haldiram's
restaurants.description: Sahara Mall GF/1F, MG Road, also at kherki Daula on NH-8. The local mega-outlet of the famous manufacturer of Indian sweets, but the emphasis here is on the fast food, especially their versions of Delhi chaat. Try the Raj Kachori, a crispy bowl filled with stuffing, yoghurt and spicy chutneys. All chaat are under ₹50, or you can get a full daily thali for ₹128. Vegetarian.

restaurants.name: Om Sweets
restaurants.description: Sector 14 and Sector 31 markets they also have outlets in sector-4 market, sector 23 market and sector 57's hongkong bazaar Famous for sweets like dodha rasmalai, rasgulla etc. Gol gappa jalebi kulfi and paneer tikka are some of the favourites Indian cuisine is good, only vegetarian food is available

restaurants.name: Roots - Cafe in the Park
restaurants.description: A rustic cafe to get breakfast or brunch. It is situated inside a park and has notoriously long waiting lines on the weekend. They have a variety of egg dishes but no meat. Closes at 8PM.

restaurants.name: Ki Hangla
restaurants.description: A small, authentic Bengali cuisine joint run as a family affair. The rolls here are recommended and so is the fish. They are generous with their mustard so be aware. Costs ₹350-400 per head.

restaurants.name: Khaaja Chowk!
restaurants.description: Simultaneously retro and modern, you can choose to dine at glass tables or inside a pimped-out autorickshaw. The speciality here is Indian street food, and the Great Indian Chaat Platter (₹130) is worthy of the name.

restaurants.name: The Pasta Bowl Company
restaurants.description: A charming, small cafe specializing in gourmet pastas. Their menu is seasonal and includes a limited set of pizzas and wines. It is a popular place so get there early or book a table in advance.
restaurants.address: Cross Point Mall, DLF Phase IV

restaurants.name: China Club
restaurants.description: Fancy Chinese restaurant with waiters in bowties and round tables, serving up actual Chinese food (as opposed to the Chindian variety) for a premium price. Try the Szechuan double-cooked pork.
restaurants.address: Lobby Level, Tower C, Global Business Park, MG Rd

attractions.name: Devi Talab Mandir
attractions.description: A replica of Amritsar Golden Temple.

attractions.name: Nikku Park
attractions.description: Nice park for strolling.

attractions.name: Nakodar
attractions.description: The town was founded by the Hindu Kamboh. The Kamboh settlements lay to the west of present town and the sites are still marked by extensive ruins and two old tombs, now called the Black and Red Domes, from the colour of the material. The large and handsome tombs dating at least from the times of Jahangir, the fourth Moghul Emperor (1569 – 1627). One of them is said to be the burial place of the adviser of Emperor Shah Jahan, but it is not known who is buried in the other tomb.

attractions.name: Pushpa Gujral Science City
attractions.description: Almost all students in Punjab are taken on school trips to visit Science City.

attractions.name: Wonderland
attractions.description: One the best place for enjoyment for one day outing for the entire family with thrilling rides, water games and many more.

restaurants.name: The Great Kabab Factory
restaurants.description: A wide selection of vegetarian and non-vegetarian kababs and curries

restaurants.name: Headquarters
restaurants.description: Mixed cuisine

restaurants.name: Heat 7
restaurants.description: Fast food restaurant. Indian, Punjabi, Chinese and other dishes

restaurants.name: Lovely Sweets
restaurants.description: Candy store

restaurants.name: Pahwa Kulfi House
restaurants.description: [https://www.facebook.com/pages/Pahwa-Kulfi-House-Model-Town-Market-Jalandhar/178470325639283]

restaurants.name: South Indian Dosa
restaurants.description: Mixed cuisine

restaurants.name: Volga Restaurant
restaurants.description: Mixed dosa and paneer dosa. The aloo tike is better from the street vendor just outside the restaurant.

restaurants.name: Billa Kulfi corner
restaurants.description: This is one of the famous kulfi corners known for kulfi and faluda rabri and affordable prices. "Milk badam" and "kesar milk" are also delicious there. Other locations: Adarsh Chopati & Model town

restaurants.name: Haveli
restaurants.description: One of the best places to eat typical Punjabi food. It hosts variety of snack stalls as well.

restaurants.name: Rangla Punjab
restaurants.description: Traditional Punjabi cuisine. The Punjabi village setting makes it one of the favorite places of everyone who visits this city. It models village houses, wells etc. It offers buffet in a typical Punjabi village home setting. The hospitality offered here reflects the open and loving hearts of Punjabi people. One can get tired of eating but the food will not stop coming. It also hosts a number of shops where you can buy the Punjabi jutis (slippers), clothes, bangles, etc. On weekends, cultural performances by singers and dancing groups is offered. Definitely a "must" visit place.

attractions.name: Ibn Sina Academy of Medieval Medicine and Sciences
attractions.description: Museum on Indian heritage and Library on History of Medieval Medicine

attractions.name: Panchala Museum
attractions.description: The collection of the museum includes prehistorical stone sculptures, goddess heads of Mauryan era, and a chariot of Gupta period. The numismatic section displays 500 coins belonging to periods earlier than that of Guptas. Most of the artifacts are from the archaeological site of Ahichatra (or Ahi-Kshetra)

attractions.name: Alakhnath Temple
attractions.description: The main centre of Naga Sanyasins belonging to the Shiva order of Anand Akhara.

attractions.name: Tapeshwar Nath Temple
attractions.description: This is the oldest temple in town.

attractions.name: Shri Hari Mandir
attractions.description: A beautiful Lord Radha Krishna Swaroop temple established in the 1960s with a big AC hall & music fountain, big garden
attractions.address: Model Town, Shahdana, Police Chuki Road

attractions.name: Fun City
attractions.description: A big amusement park including an amphitheater, a 7 Days Restaurant and a water park named Boond.

attractions.name: Pilibhit Tiger Reserve
attractions.description: One of the few well forested areas in Uttar Pradesh, 70 km away from the city centre. The reserve has its own tourist lodges.

attractions.name: Sai Mandir
attractions.address: Sai Mandir Road, Ram Ganga Vihar

attractions.name: Indra Chowk
attractions.description: Enjoy the delicacies of Moradabad, such as biryani, kebabs, paya, etc. at Gulshan-e-Karim. Get good tea right in front of Gulshan-e-Karim.

attractions.name: Prem Wonder Land and Water Kingdom
attractions.address: Prem Wonder Land Overhead Bridge, Rampur Rd

attractions.name: Bhadrakali Temple
attractions.description: One of the oldest temples for Goddess Bhadrakali, believed to be built in 625 AD by King Pulakeshin II of Chalukya dynasty.

attractions.name: Rayaparthy Shiva Temple
attractions.description: Built in the 18th century.

attractions.name: Siddeshwara Temple
attractions.description: Built in the 3rd century.

attractions.name: Thousand Pillar Temple
attractions.description: Renovated in 2004.
